content_sections.heading: DPA Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. GA/PS/1981(2026)B617 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download DPA notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: (i) MBBS degree from a recognized University; (ii) A Postgraduate Medical Degree or Postgraduate Medical Diploma from a recognized University; and (iii) Post qualification experience of sixteen years in case of Postgraduate Medical Degree holders and eighteen years experience in case of Postgraduate Medical Diploma holders in a Hospital. Experience: Post qualification experience of sixteen years in case of Postgraduate Medical Degree holders and eighteen years experience in case of Postgraduate Medical Diploma holders in a Hospital Age limit: Maximum 50 years Age relaxation: Ex-Serviceman By the length of military service increased by 3 years in case of Ex-service men and commissioned officers including ECOs / SSCOs subject to applicable conditions / rules as per Government order, Major Port Employees Up to the age of 55 years Other conditions: Must be a Citizen of India, a subject of Nepal or Bhutan, a Tibetan refugee who came before 1 January 1962, or a person of Indian origin migrated from listed countries Qualifications must be from recognized Indian Universities/Institutes approved by UGC/AICTE Valid mark-sheets and degree/diploma certificates of essential qualifications are required Government/Semi-Govt./Autonomous Body/CPSE employees must apply through proper channel or submit NOC at the time of interview Such employees must submit length of service, pay scales, final APAR gradings, eligibility position and Vigilance Clearance

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for DPA Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates without valid Mark-sheet, Degree/Diploma certificate of essential qualifications Candidates canvassing support by direct or indirect methods are disqualified

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Pay scale will be upgraded to Rs.120000-280000/- after completion of three years regular service with the approval of the Central Government Provisional appointment pending nationality/eligibility certificate shall not exceed one year Appointment subject to medical fitness and verification of character and antecedents Withdrawal after selection by Service Selection Committee may lead to debarment from HoD level posts in all Major Port Trusts for two years

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Print-out of the online application form with recent passport size photograph affixed at top right Self-attested copies of educational certificates Copy of Birth Certificate or SSC Marksheet or School Leaving Certificate for age Self-attested documents for reservation category and nationality Certificates for age relaxation, with originals for verification

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DPA Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Register, apply and submit the application through the Online Application Portal (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways at http://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in on or before 26/12/2026. No application other than OAP shall be accepted. Take a print-out of the duly filled-in Application Form and affix a recent passport size photograph on the right hand corner at the top. Attach self-attested copies of all educational/experience/age certificates and other required relevant documents. Send it by Speed Post/Registered Post etc. to The Secretary, Deendayal Port Authority, Gandhidham, so as to reach on or before 11/01/2027.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: The crucial date for determining eligibility is the last date of closing of application, 26/12/2026 Only hard copies received by the due date will be considered; incomplete or late applications will be summarily rejected DPA is not responsible for postal delay or loss in transit Provide an active mobile number and Email-ID in the application DPA reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process at any stage Legal proceedings can be instituted only in Ahmedabad/Gandhidham

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 26 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Chief Medical Officer.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 26 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 50 years. Relaxation: Ex-Serviceman By the length of military service increased by 3 years in case of Ex-service men and commissioned officers including ECOs / SSCOs subject to applicable conditions / rules as per Government order, Major Port Employees Up to the age of 55 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs.100000-260000 (IDA pattern), to be upgraded to Rs.120000-280000 after three years of regular service with Central Government approval.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBBS degree from a recognized University; Postgraduate Medical Degree or Postgraduate Medical Diploma from a recognized University; 16 years post-qualification experience in a Hospital for PG Degree holders or 18 years for PG Diploma holders.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a Citizen of India, a subject of Nepal or Bhutan, a Tibetan refugee who came before 1 January 1962, or a person of Indian origin migrated from listed countries. Qualifications must be from recognized Indian Universities/Institutes approved by UGC/AICTE. Valid mark-sheets and degree/diploma certificates of essential qualifications are required. Government/Semi-Govt./Autonomous Body/CPSE employees must apply through proper channel or submit NOC at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates without valid Mark-sheet, Degree/Diploma certificate of essential qualifications. Candidates canvassing support by direct or indirect methods are disqualified.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Pay scale will be upgraded to Rs.120000-280000/- after completion of three years regular service with the approval of the Central Government. Provisional appointment pending nationality/eligibility certificate shall not exceed one year. Appointment subject to medical fitness and verification of character and antecedents.

faq.answer: Gandhidham.
